description: This Java class 'HttpUtils' provides utility functions for processing HTTP requests and responses within an Eclipse Hono service. It includes methods for handling errors, extracting headers, writing JSON data to responses, and various HTTP-related helper functions.

classes.name: HttpUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling HTTP request and response scenarios, error handling, header extraction, and response writing within the context of an Eclipse Hono service using Vert.x.

methods.name: badRequest
methods.description: Fails a routing context with a 400 Bad Request error and an optional message.

methods.name: internalServerError
methods.description: Fails a routing context with a 500 Internal Server Error and an optional message.

methods.name: serviceUnavailable
methods.description: Fails a routing context with a 503 Service Unavailable status and sets the Retry-After header, with an overload allowing a detail message.

methods.name: unauthorized
methods.description: Fails a routing context with a 401 Unauthorized error and sets the WWW-Authenticate header.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Fails a routing context with a specified ServiceInvocationException error.

methods.name: failWithHeaders
methods.description: Fails a routing context with a specified ServiceInvocationException and HTTP headers.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Retrieves the 'Content-Type' header value from the routing context.

methods.name: isEmptyNotification
methods.description: Checks if the request contains an empty notification based on its Content-Type.

methods.name: getTimeTillDisconnect
methods.description: Extracts the 'Time Till Disconnect' value from headers or query parameters, parsed as Integer.

methods.name: getTimeToLive
methods.description: Retrieves the 'Time To Live' duration from headers or query parameters, parsed as Duration.

methods.name: getCommandResponseStatus
methods.description: Gets the 'Command Response Status' from headers or query parameters, parsed as Optional<Integer>.

methods.name: setResponseBody
methods.description: Writes JSON array, JSON object, or Buffer to the HTTP response with appropriate headers without ending the response.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Determines if an HTTP status code represents an error (4xx or 5xx).
